govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FBIDisciplining: This United Press item — FBI Disciplined 17 in JFK Case — is a wire story. The Bureau punished its own after Dallas. The news was rare. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of press history.
nonsenseorship: George Palmer Putnam hoists the flag of pure nonsense in this gay book of verses, parodies, and absurd bits. High literary airs are pricked on every page with glee. For all who like their fun bookish and their books fun, it is a rare treat.
for-auld-lang-syne-a-book-of-friendship: Ray Woodward gathers tributes to friendship — poems, essays, and warm sentiments for auld lang syne. A celebration of the bonds that sustain us through all of life's changes. The perfect gift book for friends, in any era, young or old alike.
